'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Chris Terwilliger LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Y4.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
